zh: 家里的面条吃完了，我下班得去买。
old_en: The noodles ran out at home, so I had to buy some after work.
new_en: The noodles at home are gone, so I need to buy some after work.

zh: 牛奶喝完了，我得去超市买一些。
old_en: The milk ran out, so I need to buy some from the supermarket.
new_en: The milk is finished, so I have to buy some from the supermarket.

zh: 手机的电量快用完了。
old_en: The phone's power is about to run out.
new_en: The phone's battery is almost gone.

zh: 做菜时发现盐用完了。
old_en: Cooking when I ran out of salt.
new_en: I ran out of salt while cooking.

zh: 做饭做到一半，发现盐用完了。
old_en: Cooking when I ran out of salt halfway through.
new_en: I ran out of salt halfway through cooking.

zh: 月底钱快花完了，买不了新衣服。
old_en: Money nearly ran out by the end of the month, can't buy new clothes.
new_en: By the end of the month, my money is almost gone, so I can't buy new clothes.

zh: 这个月的工资快花完了。
old_en: Wages nearly run out by the end of this month.
new_en: My salary for this month is almost gone.

zh: 打印纸用完了，今天没法打印报告了。
old_en: The ink ran out, so we couldn't print the document today.
new_en: The printer paper is used up, so I can't print the report today.

zh: 馒头吃完了，中午没东西吃了。
old_en: We ran out of food for lunch when the steamed buns were finished.
new_en: We ate all the steamed buns, so we have nothing for lunch.

zh: 手机快没电了，得赶紧充电。
old_en: The phone is running out of battery, so I need to charge it quickly.
new_en: The phone is almost out of battery, I need to charge it quickly.

zh: 出门发现汽油快用完了，得去加油站。
old_en: Running out of gas, I had to go to the gas station.
new_en: I ran out of gas when I left, I need to go to the gas station.

zh: 车快没油了，得找加油站。
old_en: The car is running out of fuel, so we need to find a gas station.
new_en: The car is almost out of fuel, we need to find a gas station.

zh: 咖啡喝完了，今天没咖啡了。
old_en: The coffee ran out today, so there's none left.
new_en: We drank all the coffee, so there's no coffee for today.

zh: 咖啡豆用完了，今天没法煮咖啡。
old_en: We've run out of coffee beans, so we can't make coffee today.
new_en: We ran out of coffee beans, so we can't make coffee today.

zh: 打印纸快用完了，记得去买新的。
old_en: The printer paper is running out, remember to buy some new ones.
new_en: The printer paper is almost gone, remember to buy some new ones.

zh: 时间快用完了，我们得抓紧。
old_en: Time is running out, so we must hurry.
new_en: Time is almost up, we need to hurry.

zh: 时间不够了，我们得加快速度。
old_en: We are running out of time, so we need to speed up.
new_en: We are running out of time, so we need to speed up.

zh: 纸巾用完了，我得去买一包。
old_en: We've run out of tissues, so I need to buy a pack.
new_en: We've run out of tissues, so I need to buy a pack.

zh: 洗洁精用完了，得去买一瓶。
old_en: We've run out of soap, so we need to buy a bar.
new_en: We've run out of dish soap, so we need to buy a bottle.

zh: 家里的米吃完了，得再去买一袋。
old_en: The rice ran out, so we need to buy another bag.
new_en: We've run out of rice, so we need to buy another bag.
